sql: SELECT MAX(n.value) FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh JOIN dim d ON d.fact_id = n.fact_id WHERE s.name = 'JOHNSON & JOHNSON' AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 1 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND d.axis = 'Subsegments'  AND n.ndims = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim e WHERE e.fact_id = n.fact_id AND e.axis = 'BusinessSegments' AND e.member = 'MedTech')
